::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Apr 4 1895  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book, Hampshire Record Office 70M92W/58/492
:::

Dear Madam
I have received all the documents from the Insurance Company & also the policy on [Mrs Yonge](people/person_1604.qmd)’s life.  As I presume the £1000 is still due to you from Mrs Yonge shall you wish to have the policy transferred into your name so as to afford you a security for the amount of any interest or premiums you have paid, or how would you like to have this arranged.[^1]

I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](people/person_2094.qmd)

Miss Yonge

---

[^1]: This relates to a policy on the life of CMY's sister-in-law Emma Frances Yonge.
